proposed_capability: One canonical million-simoleon household reserve and bounded last-resort funding and purchase decisions for the existing laundry owner.
player_save_control_impact: Source policy only. No screen takeover, save changes, cheat command, or purchase in this environment.
expected_outcome: Earn to recover and grow the reserve. Procure a verified suitable washer only after exhaustion of use/repair/refresh, using a single exact positive funding plan if needed, reconciled independent funds and a fresh whole-lot checkpoint.
negative_tests: No debit leaving less than reserve; cap overflow holds.
No console or buy under ambiguous evidence, active player, usable owned path, pending attempt or unverifiable placement.
Separate cheat proceeds from earned income and do not repeat uncertain funding/purchase.
rollback_path: Revert proposal changes; no deployed gameplay or save changes.
unresolved_unknowns: Live exact-build console visibility, funds readback, purchase/placement and washer usability require the authorized Windows host.
